The blur could be due to motion or focus, not necessarily an AI artifact. The perspective distortion noted by the Router is minor and consistent with the image's perspective. Overall, the Router's artifact observations are reasonable, but the texture anomaly severity might be overestimated given the pose auditor's findings. I will adjust the severity of the texture anomaly to 1, as it is minor and could be due to non-AI factors.
